profile.summary:
Technology leader and Enterprise Architect with 30+ years of experience delivering secure, scalable, and mission-critical solutions across federal government environments. Proven track record leading enterprise architecture, IT modernization, cloud transformation, cybersecurity initiatives, and emerging technology adoption.

Supported the Social Security Administration (SSA), where I partner with executive leadership to develop enterprise governance frameworks, reference architectures, cloud strategies, AI integration patterns, and cybersecurity solutions that drive organizational modernization. My experience spans AWS, Azure, enterprise architecture, IT governance, digital transformation, application modernization, and enterprise integration.

Throughout my career, I have architected and delivered solutions supporting millions of U.S. citizens, including public-facing digital services, enterprise data modernization initiatives, cloud monitoring frameworks, multi-factor authentication architectures, and AI-enabled solutions. I have successfully led cross-functional teams, developed enterprise technology standards, and guided organizations through complex transformation efforts while maintaining a strong focus on security, reliability, and business value.

I am passionate about leveraging cloud computing, artificial intelligence, enterprise architecture, and cybersecurity to solve complex business challenges and improve mission outcomes. My leadership philosophy centers on collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering measurable results.

Core Areas of Expertise:
• Enterprise Architecture
• IT Governance & Strategy
• Cloud Architecture (AWS & Azure)
• Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI
• Cybersecurity & Identity Management
• Digital Transformation
• Application Modernization
• Enterprise Integration & APIs
• IT Service Management (ITSM)
• Technology Leadership

Certifications include AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Developer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Fundamentals, ISC2 SSCP, ISC2 CC, and CompTIA Security+ (expected June 2026).

positions.title: IT Service Design Lead | ITSM, Cloud Operations & Cybersecurity
positions.locationName: Anne Arundel County, Maryland, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Enterprise Solutions Architect | Leidos

Support the Social Security Administration (SSA) CTO organization as an Enterprise Solutions Architect, leading enterprise architecture, governance, cloud modernization, cybersecurity, and AI initiatives. Partner with executive leadership to develop technology strategies, reference architectures, and modernization roadmaps that improve security, scalability, and operational efficiency.

**Key Accomplishments:**

* Led development of SSA's IT Governance Policy and OneTech Charter, strengthening enterprise governance and modernization efforts.
* Created enterprise reference architectures for AWS, ServiceNow, Microsoft Power Platform, Pega, cloud databases, and application integration services.
* Developed enterprise AI architecture patterns, including agentic AI, multi-agent systems, planning, reflection, and tool-use frameworks to accelerate responsible AI adoption.
* Finalized SSA's Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Reference Architecture, establishing standardized enterprise security controls.
* Architected Azure OpenAI integration patterns supporting generative AI capabilities for enterprise applications.
* Established enterprise REST API standards that accelerated development and improved architectural consistency.
* Supported Leidos Cyber Accelerator initiatives focused on Rust-based edge computing, intelligent sensing, and AI-enabled analytics.

**Previous Leadership Highlights:**

* Architected and delivered SSA's public-facing Electronic Protective Filing (eSPF) application supporting millions of citizens.
* Led modernization of enterprise applications through REST services, DevOps automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Directed development teams delivering mission-critical systems, including accessibility compliance, payroll information exchange, and data modernization solutions.
* Architected SSA's first enterprise MongoDB environment and advanced cloud and data modernization initiatives.
